audit.why: 4/10 favoured with a 5/10 carry threat matches the 66.67% win rate and the shape of the lane: he has one 900-range poke tool and a stack-gated all-in against a champion who never has to be within 900. Both layers agree row for row and the mirror recorded no chart correction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was framed as a Ziggs spike ('R denies his gray-health recovery window'), when Level 6 in this lane is Devour.
audit.why: Devour has no cooldown listed and 25000 range but is gated entirely on three stacks of An Acquired Taste and on him closing to Tongue Lash range. The mirror states it plainly: level 6 is Devour, and the answer to Ziggs is banking three stacks and closing to 900.
audit.corrected: At 6 Devour needs three stacks and a walk to 900 to happen — deny the third stack and his ultimate is inert.
sources: kits: tahmkench P three-stack gate, R range 25000, Q range 900

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate errors. The page calls Tongue Lash a ROOT — it slows, and only stuns at three stacks. It puts Devour in the W slot and Abyssal Dive in the R slot — they are reversed. And it claims Tongue Lash is a skillshot he cannot land at your range, when it reaches 900 against your 850.
audit.why: Riot's text: Tongue Lash damages and slows the first unit hit, heals him off champions, and applies a stack of An Acquired Taste — 'If the champion already has 3 stacks, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.' 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s at 900 range. Abyssal Dive is the W: 21/20/19/18/17s, 1000-1200 range, dive and knock up. Devour is the R. Your reach advantage is in the bounces, not the cast range.
audit.corrected: Tongue Lash slows and stacks; only the THIRD stack stuns, so break contact at two. It reaches 900 to your 850 — the bounces are your edge, not the cast. Abyssal Dive (W) is the knockup, Devour (R) is the swallow.
sources: kits: tahmkench Q text/range 900/cd 7-5, W Abyssal Dive range 1000-1200 cd 21-17, R Devour, P An Acquired Taste

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d sells a 'fifteen-second invitation' off Abyssal Dive, and breakdown.cooldowns gives no number at all.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive is 21 seconds at rank 1, not fifteen — the window is longer than the page claims, and naming it correctly is what makes the step-up advice usable.
audit.corrected: Abyssal Dive: 21 seconds at rank 1 over 1000 units.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thick Skin is described only as gray health, never as an active.
audit.why: Thick Skin is a 3-second, 0-cost active that converts all stored damage into a shield — so chip does not simply expire, he can bank it and cash it on demand. That is also why anti-heal timing decides long trades, which _missing/tahmkench.json flags.
audit.corrected: Thick Skin converts stored damage into a shield on a 3-second active — anti-heal is what stops the cash-out.
sources: kits: tahmkench E text, cd 3, cost 0

notes: Worst defect in my slice so far: the page had Tahm Kench's slots reversed, calling Devour his W and Abyssal Dive his R, in four places. It also called Tongue Lash a root — it slows, and stuns only when it lands the third stack of An Acquired Taste, which is the single most actionable fact in the lane (break contact at two). Third, whys[0] claimed his Q is a skillshot he cannot land at your range; it reaches 900 against your 850, so the reach advantage is in the bounces, exactly as the mirror recorded. Corrected a wrong number as well: Abyssal Dive is 21s at rank 1, sold on the page as fifteen. Per the mirror's explicit warning I did NOT propagate the '_missing-interactions.json: Ziggs bypasses stacking resistances (Satchel Charge)' line — Riot's Satchel Charge text has no percent-health component and the flag is a parsing misfire.
